CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: true when the weekly auto-updater should re-run scoring. Due when the record has never been triggered, was last triggered more than about a week ago, or has a call or logged activity on or after the last trigger date. Read by the Weekly Milestone Auto-Update flow.
CustomField.formula: OR(ISBLANK(Last_Update_Triggered__c), Last_Update_Triggered__c < NOW() - 6.5, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Meeting_Call__c)), Last_Meeting_Call__c >= DATEVALUE(Last_Update_Triggered__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.LastActivityDate)), Opportunity__r.LastActivityDate >= DATEVALUE(Last_Update_Triggered__c)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when this record is due for the weekly rescore: no trigger in the past week, or a newer call or activity since the last one.
CustomField.label: PH refresh due
